about: IOA entrance dressing (tools/geo/ioa_entrance_dress.py; src/world/ioa-entrance-dress.ts). Plants [kind, x, y, z, r, yaw, tint] on the 8.1a planters' mulch and the edge beds; props' floors are found at run time on the walk collision.
